spellbook.finance/limitations: Delegated writes require workspace owner role; membership and the existing legacy Pro write gate remain backend-enforced. Supply one expectedBins entry per unique Item from a prior query. A missing Item or changed bin rejects the entire batch with HTTP 409. After a timeout, reusing the old observation can conflict: read again. HTTP success does not prove physical placement; confirm each Item's bin, status, and reservation with a fresh query.

description: Save up to 25 existing Item bin locations after comparing each expectedBins observation with current state. A fresh Item query is required before and after the save.

expectedBins.description: One prior-bin observation per itemId in itemIds, up to 25. Required; a missing or changed Item rejects the whole batch.

binId.description: The bin this Item was last observed in, before the move. Required.

itemId.description: The Item id this observation is about. Required.

itemIds.description: Up to 25 exact Item ids to move, from a prior spellbook_inventory_items_query. Required, at least one.

sourceSignalId.description: An id linking this confirmation to its originating signal. Omit when there is none.

toBin.description: The bin these Items are being confirmed into. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the Items belong to. Required.

name: spellbook_inventory_location_confirm
